SOFTDRINK 2K28
https://github.com/cruuz/softdrink-2k28

SOFTDRINK 2K28 is an unofficial community modification prepared for Noah
(SOFTDRINKTV), with work by cruuz, Claude, and Codex. NFL2K5-PC does not bundle
the .2k5patch; the player supplies a patch obtained from its official release.

The patch contains no playable retail game by itself. A clean, legally owned
USA Xbox copy of ESPN NFL 2K5 is required. Team, league, game, and broadcast
names and marks belong to their respective owners.
